decisions.statement: An account holds one inventory, in one data file beside the account's own page.
The account read is the one the call runs as.
An account with no data file refuses the call.
Nothing here reaches the page store over the network.
The record is answered as JSON whether or not `--json` is said.
So `--json` here takes the indenting off rather than choosing JSON.

definition: the command giving back the inventory an account holds as one whole record
